sloka: शिरसा धरणीं प्राप्य प्रययौ यत्र राघवः ।द्वाःस्थस्त्वागम्य रामाय सर्वानेव कृताञ्जलिः ।निवेदयामास तदा भ्रातऽन्स्वान्समुपस्थितान् ।। ७.४४.११ ॥
transliteration: śirasā dharaṇīṁ prāpya prayayau yatra rāghavaḥ ।dvāḥsthastvāgamya rāmāya sarvāneva kṛtāñjaliḥ ।nivedayāmāsa tadā bhrāta'nsvānsamupasthitān ।। 7.44.11 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna, having bowed his head to the ground, went to where Rama was, and then the doorkeeper, with folded hands, reported to Rama that all his brothers had arrived.
